name: B10-0299/2025 (PPE) – Case of Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to release Ahmadreza Djalali, a Swedish-Iranian doctor held since 2016 and sentenced to death after what it calls an unfair trial. It says his health is failing and he is being denied proper medical care. The Parliament also asks Iran to drop all charges, free all political prisoners on death row, stop executions, and release detained European Union citizens.

- No law changes; the Parliament is stating its opinion and making requests to Iran.
- It concerns Djalali, other prisoners on death row, and detained EU citizens.
- The resolution is sent to EU institutions and Iran's government and parliament; no action is required of them.
